basic_info.description: Marvelous Home!  For the first time in 67 years, this beloved family home is available. Built in 1958 with the solid construction of its era and lovingly maintained ever since, it sits on one of the best blocks in the neighborhoodjust a half block from the park.  Upstairs, you'll find a light-filled floor plan with beautifully maintained parquet floors featuring three spacious bedrooms and one bathroom:  stall shower, separate tub and skylight. The inviting living room with fireplace that captures partial bay views flows seamlessly into a formal dining room, while the bright eat-in kitchen provides the perfect hub for entertaining.  The lower level offers incredible flexibility, with a two-car garage and a master suite with ADA shower that opens directly to the private backyardideal for entertaining, gardening, or simply relaxing outdoors.  Interior access from garage parking to all living spaces.  Lovingly updated over the years, this timeless home combines mid-century quality with modern comforts, all in an unbeatable location close to parks, schools, and neighborhood amenities.
